A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProDistill study. The main text, equations, Tables 1–10, Figures 1–13, and Appendices A–D are readable and can be reliably matched across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-merging experiments on vision, language understanding, and language generation, together with ablations, efficiency measurements, and randomness analyses in Sections 5–6 and Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including ProDistill benchmark scores, ablations, efficiency measurements, and the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same element-wise merging coefficients, feature-distillation objectives, progressive layer-wise optimization, and paired merged-model and expert-model activations.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight vision datasets, eight GLUE tasks, and five instruction, mathematics, and code-generation benchmarks. The additional coverage in Appendix D is also unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparator sets are unchanged. Figure 5's RoBERTa legend changes from DirectDistill to DistillMerge, but its caption and Appendix C.2 already identify that comparison as DistillMerge in v1. This resolves a labeling inconsistency rather than establishing a comparator replacement.

E3.justification: Sections 5–6 and Appendix B retain the same model configurations, validation sampling, evaluation metrics, hyperparameter grids, and training budgets. The efficiency and ablation protocols are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The coefficient-granularity, end-to-end distillation, standard-training, and dual-input ablations in Appendix C are retained. Efficiency analyses, t-SNE visualizations, and generation examples in Section 6 and Appendix D test the same questions with unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: Appendix D.3 retains the same three-random-seed experiments for ViT-B-32 and RoBERTa. Figure 9's boxplots and the discussion of variability across validation-shot counts are unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical tables, plotted results, and generation examples are unchanged. For example, ProDistill retains the 86.04% ViT-B-32 average in Table 1, the 0.7641 RoBERTa average in Table 2, and the 0.8288 normalized Code-and-Math average in Table 3.

T1.justification: Theorems 3.1 and 3.2, their assumptions and Appendix A proofs, and the mathematical definitions and optimization objectives are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about domain-specific data, progressive distillation, performance improvements of 6.14% and 6.61%, and scalability beyond 10B parameters.

C2.justification: Interpretations of worst-case hardness, feature supervision, dual activations, and data scarcity remain unchanged. The new Impact Statement supplies broad sustainability and accessibility context plus generic privacy, bias, and misuse cautions, without a substantive new interpretation or applicability limitation.

D1.justification: Appendix B.3 retains the same implementation and data-processing details. The existing code-repository disclosure moves from Section 5 to an introduction footnote; its access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Anonymous (2024) is updated to Dai et al. (2025), with the same paper title and OpenReview identifier. This is a publication-attribution update; the cited-work set and the substantive comparisons in Sections 4.2 and 7 remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Impact Statement, updates affiliations, correspondence information and publication text, relocates the code disclosure, updates citation metadata, and fixes spacing in Appendix C.4. The scientific prose and section organization are largely retained.

P2.justification: Figure 5's RoBERTa-panel legend is corrected from DirectDistill to DistillMerge. Table 3 moves from page 7 to page 8, with associated text and figure reflow. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 5's legend resolves a concrete ambiguity between DistillMerge and the distinct DirectDistill baseline defined in Appendix C.3, bringing the plot into agreement with its caption and Appendix C.2. This modestly improves clarity; the theory, experiments, and results remain unchanged.
